_notes.aggregate_rule: S19 renders A1, A2, A3, A4 as four separate rows. Per PRD §11: 'Never average A1–A4 into a single motivation score.' The engine MUST NOT combine activation levels; 'aggregate': false on S19 is structural, not advisory.
_notes.narrative_reference_rule: This config is structure only. Screens reference approved narrative keys from config/narratives-v1.0.json, config/connection-statements-v1.0.json, and config/signal-state-vocabulary-v1.0.json. No participant-facing sentence may be authored, edited, or paraphrased here — copy lives only in those libraries.
_notes.s18_rule: S18 renders only when a perception-gap key is triggered by the deterministic engine (Q2 starting view vs assessed profile). No gap key => screen omitted, numbering of remaining screens unchanged.
_notes.s21_rule: Per UIUX §22: the 'Not Right Now' continuation path must not be hidden, punished, or preselected. All four paths carry 'preselect': null and 'deprioritize': false.
_notes.titles: The 'title' strings are approved participant-facing copy reproduced exactly; they are identifiers, not narrative.
